item: every memory verdict reads the cgroup limit through one helper (R302 follow-up)
key_paths: src/config/cgroup_memory.py; src/config/memory_budget.py; src/config/machine_floor.py; src/scheduler/memguard.py; src/monitoring/collect_perf.py; tests/test_memory_verdicts_cgroup.py
summary: The resident budget's tier, the whole-corpus scan floor and the memory guard (between passes and during one) read psutil's host figures, so inside a container or service memory limit they sized for and judged by the host's gigabytes while the kernel killed at the limit. All now go through cgroup_memory.effective_memory: total = min(machine total, smallest cgroup limit at any level), available = min(machine available, tightest cgroup room with reclaimable cache), each with total_from / available_from (cgroup limit / machine / machine with an unreadable limit; given for a passed-in figure). total_ram_mb() stays the hardware figure for hardware_reading and the diagnostics bundle. Helper measured at 0.16 ms per call. backup/merge.py's own _total_ram_mb is left for the data durability lane.
